The works the tracks and workshops are built on, grouped by topic. Under each entry: where on the site it is used.
Journal articles and books with a DOI were checked against their Crossref records; software citations come from each
package's own `citation()`, for the versions used to build the site (November 2026).

::: {.callout-tip}
## Citing R and packages in your own work
Run `citation()` for R and `citation("package")` for each package you used, and report the versions (`sessionInfo()`).
The Regression workshop, Session 6, shows a methods paragraph that does this.
:::

<style>.ref-used { color: #5f6b76; font-size: 0.88em; }</style>
